from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class YangheQuarterNetAsset(BaseModel):
    """One quarterly net asset data point from a Yanghe financial report."""
    year: str = Field(description="The year of this reporting period")
    quarter: str = Field(description="Which quarter (e.g., Q1, Q3)")
    report_end_date: str = Field(description="Specific end date of the reporting period, e.g., '2015-03-31'")
    net_asset_value: float = Field(description="Net asset value attributable to shareholders in yuan")
    comparison_year_end_value: float | None = Field(description="Previous year-end net asset value for comparison, if provided")
    
class Parse(BaseModel):
    quarterly_net_asset_reports: list[YangheQuarterNetAsset]
